loaderContract.index: src/lib/culture/data/index.ts -> default { version: 1, chunkSize, entries: CultureIndexEntry[] }
loaderContract.ordering: entries are in the same global order as the concatenated chunks; chunk = floor(position / chunkSize)
loaderContract.version: compare index.version / manifest.CULTURE_DATA_VERSION with CULTURE_SCHEMA_VERSION from src/lib/culture/types.ts
loaderContract.lazy: import the index statically; load chunk-<k>.ts on demand (import.meta.glob or explicit dynamic import); never import every chunk up front
